 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Coliseum rolls out the red carpet this Thursday as it welcomes FC Lugano for matchday two of the Conference League.
 José Bordalás's Getafe CF aim to build on the point earned against Craiova as they seek their first European home win in six years. Without the unregistered Carvajal or the injured Romero, Mangala and Azón, the Azulones need to sharpen their attack. Meanwhile, Mattia Croci-Torti's Swiss side arrive brimming with confidence as domestic league leaders, having beaten Red Star 2-1 in their European opener.
